INDEPENDENT GUIDE POLICY

Privacy

This page explains the limited information used to operate this independent guide.

01020304
01

Information we use

We use only what is necessary for the site to operate: basic browsing signals that servers normally receive, essential browser storage, and information that you voluntarily send through a contact method if one is offered.

02

How it is used

Information may help us maintain the guide, understand broad usage patterns, respond to requests and meet applicable obligations. This project does not sell visitor profiles.

03

Third-party services

Google Maps is embedded for orientation. Google Analytics is loaded only after you choose to allow analytics. Those providers apply their own policies to their services.

04

Your choices

You may change the analytics setting at any time on the Cookie settings page. Rights available to you depend on applicable law and the data actually processed.
